For basic species information, please refer to the guidebook in game
The purpose of this article is to got in depth in the mechanics of each species

== Arachnid ==
<code>>88w88<</code>
* Meat type: spider meat
* Blood type: copper blood
* Default attack: bite (5 piercing)
* reagent interactions
** Water (touch): water droplet hat
** Water, space cleaner (touch): wash cream pie
* Special emotes: '@Click', '@Chitter'
* Carriable: yes

===Low oxygen exchange===
Arachnids take 50% more asphyxiation damage from all sources.
Arachnids heal asphyxiation damage at half the normal rate through access to oxygen.

===Extra pocket slots===
Arachnids have two extra "web" slots, which acts as pockets.

=== Sericulture ===
Arachnids can produce 1 silk for the cost of 4 hunger.
At full satiety, this allows an arachnid to produce 25 silk

===SpiderCraft===
Can craft special recipes, transforming silk into other items using the crafting menu
(x) indicating the cost in silk
* Classic web poncho (12)
* Web bed (6)
* Web chair (3)
* Web cloak (12)
* Web crate (10)
* Web door (10)
* Web jumpskirt (8)
* Web jumpsuit (8)
* Web nest (6)
* Web poncho (12)
* Web Shield (12)
* Web table (4)
* Web tile (1)
* Web wall (4)
* Web winter boots (2)
* Web winter coat (5)

== Diona ==
* Meat type: plant meat
* Blood type: sap
* Default attack: fist (5 blunt)
* reagent interactions
** Water (touch): water droplet hat
** Water, space cleaner (touch): wash cream pie
* Special emotes: '@Click', '@Chitter'
* Carriable: yes

===Plant respiration===
Dionas take half the asphyxiation damage from breathing.
Dionas do not heal asphyxiation damage from breathing


== Human ==
The guidebook says that they have no remarkable attributes. This is a lie.
Humans have access to the @belch emote
You are welcome.
